properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Kept as an idea by @ajs, 2026-10-22.

FROM Tao (same page): "Normalize responsible disclosure: disclose actual chat logs, not merely that AI was used, so failures and iteration become visible." Also: "making disclosure of AI use routine".

TODAY: every ChangeEvent the agent records ends "Session: <conversation link>" (the agent's standing practice, from flo2's accepted 1a97fc1f1de4d5d2:dec:idea-a-change-names-the-model-and-session-that-made-it, 2026-10-10, option b). That decision left the MODEL LABEL, readable agent names and in-session pointers as considered. Commits already carry "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5". Design records do not.

OPTIONS:
(a) ChangeEvent (or AUTHORED_BY by an agent) carries the model id and harness, from the caller, as recorded and never inferred;
(b) the session link only, as today; the transcript holds the rest;
(c) both, plus a disclosure line in read-backs ("these steps were written by an agent; none confirmed").

PUSHBACK:
- A model label is easy to state and hard to verify. reflow2 cannot check what model called it, so it would be asserted.
- The session link already gives the full log, which is what Tao asks for. (c)'s read-back line is arguably the more useful half: who confirmed nothing is already computed (confirmation readings).

SIZE (a finding): (a) small; (b) nothing; (c) small.

Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
